typography.rules: Use tracking-tight for large metrics (3xl/4xl). Use uppercase tracking-wide for small overlines/labels (xs). Never center-align dense data.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this specific data-dense dashboard area. Stick to solid #FFFFFF and #F2F2F7 for maximum clarity and iOS native feel.
visual enhancers.shadows: Use subtle shadow-sm for active segmented control tabs and interactive mold cards on hover. Avoid heavy or muddy shadows.
visual enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for main cards/KPIs, rounded-lg for inputs/segmented tabs, rounded-full for badges and progress bars.

component name.SegmentedControl: iOS-style view switcher. Wrapper: bg-[#F2F2F7] p-1 rounded-lg flex gap-1. Active tab: bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm text-[#111111] font-bold transition-transform. Inactive tab: text-[#636366] font-semibold hover:text-[#111111].
component name.KPICard: bg-[#F2F2F7] rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-1. Label: text-xs text-[#636366] uppercase font-bold tracking-wide. Value: text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#111111].
component name.HorizontalBar: Flex container representing distribution. Use a base div.bg-[#E5E5EA] rounded-full h-2 w-full, with an absolute inner div colored by the mold's catalog color representing the percentage.
component name.MoldCard: bg-white border border-[#E5E5EA] rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md transition-all. If it is the most used mold, apply border-[#007AFF] and a small primary badge 'Más utilizado'.
component name.TypeMatrixHeader: bg-[#F2F2F7] px-3 py-2 rounded-md font-bold text-sm text-[#111111] flex justify-between mt-6 first:mt-0
component name.MatrixRow: flex items-center justify-between py-2.5 border-b border-[#E5E5EA] text-[13px] text-[#3A3A3C]

layouts.page_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-6. Expand from the original max-w-3xl to 4xl to accommodate denser dashboard views.
layouts.sections: Vertical stack with gap-6 (24px) spacing between major sections (Filters, Segmented Switcher, Active View Content).
layouts.action_bar: Flex row containing PDF/Excel exports and a manual refresh button, placed below filters or adjacent to the switcher.

motion.tabs: Transition background-color and box-shadow on segmented control items.
motion.cards: Transition transform and box-shadow on hover for Mold Cards (duration 200ms ease-out).
motion.views: Apply a simple fade-in (opacity 0 to 1) when switching between dashboard views.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on primary/success/error colors meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.test_ids: Every interactive element MUST have a data-testid (e.g., report-view-switcher, tab-resumen, tab-tarjetas, tab-matriz, kpi-asignados, mold-card-{name}, refresh-button).
accessibility.semantics: Use proper heading levels (h2, h3) for matrix groupings.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Suggested: BarChart2 (Resumen), LayoutGrid (Tarjetas), List (Matriz), RefreshCw (Refresh).

3d libraries.usage: None required for this 2D incremental dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend `ReportsPage.jsx` by introducing a state for the active view: `const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState('resumen')`.
Build a SegmentedControl component to switch between 'resumen', 'tarjetas', and 'matriz'.

Resumen View (Default): Add a KPI Grid at the top (Paneles asignados, Paneles sin asignar, Moldes utilizados). Calculate these from `data.total`, `data.con_molde`, `data.sin_molde`, and the unique molds in `data.resumen`. Below KPIs, render Horizontal Bars for each mold showing color, name, and count relative to the highest count. Keep the original detail table at the bottom of this view.

Tarjetas View: Display a responsive grid of `MoldCard`s based on `data.resumen`. Each card must show mold name, type, color dot, and panel count. Add a sort select (Sort by Count DESC / Sort by Name ASC). Highlight the card with the highest count (Más utilizado).

Matriz View: Group `data.resumen` by `tipo` (Curvo, Liso, Borde de losa). Render a table-like list where each Type has a `TypeMatrixHeader` showing the subtotal, followed by `MatrixRow`s for each mold. Add a Grand Total row at the end.
Add a manual refresh button next to the export buttons. Keep track of the last refresh time and show it as a small label (e.g., 'Actualizado 10:42').
Strictly preserve the existing iOS-Native visual language (colors #F2F2F7, #E5E5EA, #111111).
Ensure the dashboard is responsive from 320px to 1920px.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text should flow naturally (left-aligned).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
Never use placeholder URLs or Emoji characters for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
